title: Last-Mile Tracking — Specialty Home Delivery (6 pharmacies, 3 couriers, Maharashtra and Karnataka)
summary: About 2,400 specialty and cold-chain home deliveries a month against a 24-hour promise: serial scans at hand-over, at the door and on return checked against packaging line (L3) serials, OTP proof of delivery with door temperature and GPS distance, data-logger readings, route exceptions with ops sign-off and a maker-checker QA sign-off for excursions and damage, returns with QA-approved destruction, courier webhooks, ERP confirmations, a control-tower dashboard and delivery and partner 360 pages.
